title: Vintage Italian Hand-Painted Majolica Ceramic Set – Faenza Style Decorative Collection
description:
Beautiful vintage Italian majolica ceramic ensemble composed of 3 matching hand-painted pieces: a covered pedestal urn and two decorative lidded trinket/bonbon boxes. Featuring elegant Renaissance-inspired floral motifs with rich cobalt blue, olive green, terracotta and gold accents, this collection perfectly captures the timeless charm of traditional Italian craftsmanship.
Hand-painted in Italy in the Faenza majolica style, these pieces make a stunning statement for Mediterranean, maximalist or classic interiors. Ideal for collectors of Italian ceramics, decorative pottery, or refined vintage décor.
The set is in very good vintage condition with vibrant colors and glossy finish. Minor signs of age underneath consistent with vintage handcrafted ceramics.
A rare and highly decorative ensemble that looks beautiful displayed together on a console, shelf or dining room cabinet.
Sold as a set of 3 pieces.
Made in Italy – hand painted.
